name.value: Salt Spring Wild Cider House Kitchen

description.value: Salt Spring Wild Cider House Kitchen is a farm-based cidery and restaurant on Salt Spring Island, serving scratch-made food designed to pair with their diverse lineup of artisanal ciders pressed from heritage apples and pears grown across the island. The setting overlooks an orchard and valley with all-day sun, and both indoor seating and an outdoor picnic area are available, with walk-ins welcome. Families and pets are welcome, making it a relaxed stop for touring cyclists exploring Salt Spring Island's rural roads.
